items.source: emf - the EntityManagerFactory to create the EntityManager with
items.translation: emf - 用于创建 EntityManager 的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source: the EntityManager, or null if none found
items.translation: EntityManager，或如果未找到则为null

items.source: Obtain a JPA EntityManager from the given factory.
items.translation: 从给定的工厂获取一个 JPA EntityManager。

items.source: Note: Will return null if no thread-bound EntityManager found!
items.translation: 注意：如果未找到线程绑定的 EntityManager，将返回null！

items.source: Same as getEntityManager, but throwing the original PersistenceException.
items.translation: 与getEntityManager相同，但抛出原始的 PersistenceException。

items.source: properties - the properties to be passed into the createEntityManager call (may be null)
items.translation: properties - 要传递给 createEntityManager 调用的属性（可为 null）

items.source: DataAccessResourceFailureException - if the EntityManager couldn't be obtained
items.translation: DataAccessResourceFailureException - 如果无法获取 EntityManager

items.source: jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException - if the EntityManager couldn't be created
items.translation: jakarta.persistence.PersistenceException - 如果无法创建 EntityManager

items.source: The specified unit name will be matched against the configured persistence unit, provided that a discovered EntityManagerFactory implements the EntityManagerFactoryInfo interface. If not, the persistence unit name will be matched against the Spring bean name, assuming that the EntityManagerFactory bean names follow that convention.
items.translation: 指定的单元名称将与配置的持久化单元进行匹配，前提是发现的 `EntityManagerFactory` 实现了 `EntityManagerFactoryInfo` 接口。如果不是，则持久化单元名称将与 Spring bean 名称进行匹配，假设 `EntityManagerFactory` bean 名称遵循该约定。

items.source: If no unit name has been given, this method will search for a default EntityManagerFactory through BeanFactory.getBean(Class).
items.translation: 如果未指定单元名称，此方法将通过BeanFactory.getBean(Class)搜索默认的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source: Mainly intended for internal use within the framework.
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部。

items.source: This method sets the JPA query hint "jakarta.persistence.query.timeout" accordingly.
items.translation: 此方法相应地设置 JPA 查询提示"jakarta.persistence.query.timeout"。

items.source:
The most important cases like object not found or optimistic locking failure
are covered here. For more fine-granular conversion, JpaTransactionManager etc
support sophisticated translation of exceptions via a JpaDialect.
items.translation: 最重要的情况，如对象未找到或乐观锁失败，在此处涵盖。对于更细粒度的转换，JpaTransactionManager 等通过 JpaDialect 支持复杂的异常翻译。

items.source:
Close the given JPA EntityManager,
catching and logging any cleanup exceptions thrown.
items.translation: 关闭给定的 JPA EntityManager，捕获并记录任何清理过程中抛出的异常。

items.source:
Order value for TransactionSynchronization objects that clean up JPA
EntityManagers. Return DataSourceUtils.CONNECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER - 100
to execute EntityManager cleanup before JDBC Connection cleanup, if any.
items.translation: 用于清理 JPA EntityManagers 的 TransactionSynchronization 对象的订单值。返回 `DataSourceUtils.CONNECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER` - 100，以便在（如有）JDBC 连接清理之前执行 EntityManager 清理。

items.source:
• DataSourceUtils.CONNECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER
  • Constant Field Values
items.translation:
• DataSourceUtils.CONNECTION_SYNCHRONIZATION_ORDER
  • 常量字段值

items.source: unitName - the name of the persistence unit (may be null or empty, in which case a single bean of type EntityManagerFactory will be searched for)
items.translation: `unitName` - 持久化单元的名称（可为 `null` 或空，此时将搜索类型为 EntityManagerFactory 的单个 Bean）

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if there is no such EntityManagerFactory in the context
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果上下文中不存在该 EntityManagerFactory

items.source: em - the JPA EntityManager to close (may be null)
items.translation: em - 要关闭的 JPA EntityManager（可能为 null）

items.source: beanFactory - the ListableBeanFactory to search
items.translation: beanFactory - 要搜索的 ListableBeanFactory

items.source: query - the JPA Query object
items.translation: query - JPA 查询对象

items.source: emf - the JPA EntityManagerFactory that the Query was created for
items.translation: emf - 创建该查询的 JPA EntityManagerFactory

items.translation: ex - 运行时异常

items.source: the corresponding DataAccessException instance, or null if the exception should not be translated
items.translation: 对应的 DataAccessException 实例，或者如果不应转换该异常则为null。

items.source: the EntityManagerFactory
items.translation: EntityManagerFactory

items.source: Convert the given runtime exception to an appropriate exception from the org.springframework.dao hierarchy.
items.translation: 将给定的运行时异常转换为 org.springframework.dao 层次结构中的适当异常。

items.source:
Order value for TransactionSynchronization objects that clean up JPA
EntityManagers.
items.translation: 用于清理 JPA EntityManagers 的 TransactionSynchronization 对象的 Order 值。

items.source: Apply the current transaction timeout, if any, to the given JPA Query object.
items.translation: 如果存在，将当前的事务超时时间应用于给定的 JPA 查询对象。

items.source:
Find an EntityManagerFactory with the given name in the given
Spring application context (represented as ListableBeanFactory).
items.translation: 在给定的 Spring 应用程序上下文（表示为 ListableBeanFactory）中查找具有给定名称的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source: synchronizedWithTransaction - whether to automatically join ongoing transactions (according to the JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType rules)
items.translation: synchronizedWithTransaction - 是否根据 JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType 规则自动加入正在进行的交易。
